description: This file provides the implementation of the ListCVDsAction, which lists CVDs (Cloud Virtual Devices) managed by the CVD CLI within the host orchestrator component. It includes functions for creating the action, running it, and handling group filtering, as well as necessary imports and associated data structures.

classes.name: ListCVDsActionOpts
classes.description: Options for configuring the ListCVDsAction, including group filter, paths, execution context, and user information.

classes.name: ListCVDsAction
classes.description: Represents the action to list available CVDs, including internal state and CLI interface.

methods.name: NewListCVDsAction
methods.description: Constructor for creating a new ListCVDsAction with specified options.

methods.name: Run
methods.description: Executes the action to retrieve and return a list of CVDs, optionally filtered by group.
